Detailed Description

Base class for the musical events.

This class knows information about start time and duration and lets the user to inherit from it to create actual events. It knows about the spatial position of the sound and it's a specialization of SoundGenerator with the type SoundFrame for the tick () function.

void SoundEvent::update ( Subject *  s  )  [virtual]

This class removes from the formal interface the method 'update' by defining it.

In this way the derived classes must not implement this method; this because in the tick () function of the derived classes should be present some objects of type SoundObject which should manage the update method.

Reimplemented in CrossFade, SpectrumDesigner, and TableGranulator.
